title: a monitor plugged in is picked up as the output

clauses.text: A real HDMI or DP monitor is plugged in and unplugged on the machine and the sound output follows it (automatic)

steps.do: Unplug the monitor's HDMI or DP cable from the machine, wait about 5 seconds, then plug it back in. Keep Settings, Sound open on the screen.
steps.expect: The Sound page changes its output to the monitor when it is plugged in and away from it when it is not, or shows no output with a reason. The sound check itself is recorded by the rig.
